source: Owner-attached generated mockup of the Chaos Clash gameplay screen (light), plus the owner's Home and Daily Clash screenshots as the reference visual family.
controls: VISUAL DIRECTION ONLY. It does not override approved behaviour, navigation or product scope.
adopt: warm cream / off-white page background (Warm Court Ivory #F1EDE4, continuous with Home's lobby canvas)
dark charcoal / navy readable text (Editorial Ink #151B24)
restrained text-grade gold (#8A6410, AA on ivory and cards) with bright Fracture Gold reserved for the ONE primary action fill under dark ink
editorial sports typography (existing display + system sans)
coherent Team Gold vs Team Blue identity

correctionsToTheMockup.keepDarkGlobalNavigation: The existing obsidian .ec-brand-header with the Mk1 logo, real destinations and real account states is retained. The mockup's light header, search, notifications and avatar menu are NOT adopted.
correctionsToTheMockup.noCoachChoicesBeforeUnlock: Coach Chaos stays hidden until roster completion (approved 9B.3 state 4). The mockup's three coach cards on the pre-roll screen are NOT adopted.
correctionsToTheMockup.noDominantEmptyResultDock: The RESULT DOCK stays subordinate during an active draft (9B.3 rule: previous results never dominate a draft). The mockup's large empty dock is NOT adopted.
correctionsToTheMockup.noProgressTrackerReplacingTheSixStates: FOUNDATION / ADAPT / COMMIT is not adopted as a state model. The approved six-state flow (Foundation, Drafting/Hold, Era Reveal, Coach Chaos, Clash Ready, Result) is unchanged; its existing step indicator is re-themed, not replaced.
correctionsToTheMockup.noDecorativeCopyAsProductTruth: 'DIFFERENT ERAS. SAME GREATNESS.', 'HISTORY MEETS COMPETITION', 'ROSTER MAXIMIZER' etc. are not adopted as product mechanics or copy.
correctionsToTheMockup.darkCenterpieceAllowed: The player cards' portrait stage keeps its dark well (the certified Phase 9A.2 jersey-visibility measurement depends on it); the matchup centre may stay dark. A wholesale dark application is not the goal.

implementationSeam: One shared token set. The production theme's arena family (productionArena in src/theme/basketballThemes.js) is re-palletted from the same Night Court reading values Home, Daily, My EraClash, the leaderboard and the Player Card already use; the generated stylesheet is rebuilt by scripts/ui/build-theme-css.mjs. The brand header is decoupled onto explicit master-brand tokens so it stays obsidian regardless of the arena palette. No page-by-page overrides, no second design system, no new dependency, no new serverless function.
